name: bubble
purpose: One step of a bubble sort of a list: the list after k compares, the pair it compares, the swap, the counts so far and the code line. Each view reads this one row, so all views show the same run.
returns: {step, last, list, bars, j, left, right, swap, did, cmp, comps, swaps, line, mark}. bars is a list for the bars block, with the compared pair in the first (strong) part and the other values in the second part. did is start, swap or keep. line is 1 at the start, 3 for a compare with no swap and 4 for a swap. mark has ▶ at that line and · at the other three.

from.doc: the path of the list of numbers

at.doc: the step, a number or a key: 0 is the list as given, a fraction rounds down, and a step past the end gives the last step
